_note: PREREGISTRATION.md §4 — every mechanical rule run against hand-made cases before the first probe request. The near-misses are the point.

results.case: policy fires when robots disallows
results.purpose: MUST fire: a published rule is a published rule even with no probe
results.machine_reason: robots.txt disallows this path for *; not probed

results.case: policy does NOT fire on a refusal with no robots rule
results.purpose: MUST NOT fire: silence in robots.txt is not a published ground

results.case: key-declared fires on 401 with WWW-Authenticate
results.purpose: MUST fire: the server published the machine-readable ground
results.machine_reason: every arm 401 and a WWW-Authenticate header was served

results.case: key-declared does NOT fire on 401 without the header
results.purpose: MUST NOT fire: a bare 401 asserts nothing a client can act on

results.case: key-declared does NOT fire on 403 with the header elsewhere
results.purpose: MUST NOT fire: 403 is not a challenge, whatever headers ride along

results.case: open fires when every arm is 2xx
results.purpose: MUST fire: 204 is 2xx; the door opened

results.case: open does NOT fire when one arm failed to get a status
results.purpose: MUST NOT fire: an unanswered arm is not an open door
results.machine_reason: mixed non-refusal outcome (5xx, 404, or transport failure)

results.case: client-string fires when named opens what urllib is refused
results.purpose: MUST fire: this is the 2026-09-11 event, as a code
results.machine_reason: at least one arm 2xx and at least one arm 401/403/429

results.case: client-string fires in the other direction too
results.purpose: MUST fire: the rule is about disagreement, not about named winning
results.machine_reason: at least one arm 2xx and at least one arm 401/403/429

results.case: client-string does NOT fire on 200 beside a 500
results.purpose: MUST NOT fire: a server fault is not a refusal
results.machine_reason: mixed non-refusal outcome (5xx, 404, or transport failure)

results.case: client-string does NOT fire on 200 beside a 404
results.purpose: MUST NOT fire: absence is not refusal — the distinction this practice has insisted on since the retrievability series
results.machine_reason: mixed non-refusal outcome (5xx, 404, or transport failure)

results.case: label_wrong fires when the register claims a key and the door opens
results.purpose: MUST fire: the note's claim is contradicted by the door
results.machine_reason: at least one arm 2xx and at least one arm 401/403/429

results.case: label_wrong does NOT fire when a key really is declared
results.purpose: MUST NOT fire: the register is right about this one
results.machine_reason: every arm 401 and a WWW-Authenticate header was served

results.case: label_wrong does NOT fire when the door refuses everyone
results.purpose: MUST NOT fire: the note may be imprecise, but nothing here contradicts it

results.case: label_wrong does NOT fire when the register claimed nothing
results.purpose: MUST NOT fire: this note states the status and claims no ground — the near-miss that separates a wrong label from a bare one
results.machine_reason: at least one arm 2xx and at least one arm 401/403/429
